decks.name: LeetCode #543 - Diameter of Binary Tree
decks.description: Find the diameter of a binary tree, the length of longest path between any two nodes

cards.question: Diameter of Binary Tree: Given the root of a binary tree, return the length of the diameter of the tree. The diameter of a binary tree is the length of the longest path between any two nodes in a tree. This path may or may not pass through the root. The length of a path between two nodes is represented by the number of edges between them.

solutions.name: Brute Force
solutions.explanation: For each node, compute diameter as sum of left and right subtree heights, then recursively check diameters of left and right subtrees. Uses separate maxHeight helper function. Recalculates heights repeatedly for same nodes leading to O(n²) time complexity. Simple but inefficient approach.

solutions.name: Depth First Search
solutions.explanation: Optimal DFS solution that computes height and updates diameter in single pass. Use nonlocal variable to track maximum diameter across all nodes. For each node, compute diameter through that node as sum of left and right heights, update global max, then return height. Efficient O(n) time with single traversal.

solutions.name: Iterative DFS
solutions.explanation: Iterative post-order DFS using stack and hashmap. Store (height, diameter) pairs for each processed node in map. Process children before parent by checking if children are in map. When both children processed, compute current node's height and diameter from children's values. O(n) time and space without recursion.
